status: registered before tile selection, AlphaEarth downloads or scoring for landslides; A1 (floods) results known, A1b pending
scenario: docs/SCENARIO_RAPID_CHANGE_20260927.md, second hazard (gate: 2 of 3 hazards must pass, docs/CVPR_SCALE_PLAN_20260927.md)
data: Sen12Landslides regions with per-date OlmoEarth v1 Base embeddings and an event since 2018: hiroshima, hokkaido, thrissur, itogon, chimanimani, italy, kyrgyzstan2, newzealand. Positive tiles: mask >= 200 px and first post-event acquisition in the region's modal event month; negatives: empty mask. <= 100 each per region, deterministic hash.
dates: event day = earliest first-post-event acquisition in the modal month among positives; per tile pre = last of the 12 clearest acquisitions before it, post = first at/after it, pre1 = the one before pre (same rule for positives and negatives)

methods.full_method: olmo_norm = (1-cos(post,pre)) / (1-cos(pre,pre1) + eps) on 40 m tokens (no 20 m zoom for S2 in v0)
methods.baseline_secondary: aef_norm (events >= 2019 only: chimanimani, italy, kyrgyzstan2, newzealand)
methods.eps: median of each method's own pre-event change over all tiles

metrics.T1: tile AUC positive vs negative (tile mean at 40 m)
metrics.T2: token AUC at 40 m inside positive tiles, mask fraction >= .5 vs 0

verdict.meaningful: full - strongest >= .05 with CI lower > 0 on T1 and T2

known_limits: regions (not independent events) are the bootstrap unit, ~8 units
S2 clouds: kept acquisitions are the clearest but not cloud-free
italy (2023) is the only post-2021 event
